notes: Wave-6 key KahaEtal08c was renamed to KahaEtal08b in HEAD (key-renames.json; the old KahaEtal08b, a duplicate of KahaEtal08a, was deleted and its suffix reused), so this decision follows the rename to HEAD KahaEtal08b (Kahana, Sederberg and Howard 2008, Psychological Review 115(4)). Crossref 10.1037/a0013724 (and PubMed 20976034) print the full title 'Putting short-term memory into context: Reply to Usher, Davelaar, Haarmann, and Goshen-Gottstein (2008).' and pages 1119-1125 (HEAD's 1119--1126 runs into the separate postscript, 1125-1126); DOI added. Author, journal, volume 115, number 4 and year 2008 are confirmed as in HEAD. Key stays KahaEtal08b (KahaEtal08a is the chapter).
